text:
[RFCS.13.1] **`embed` is concatenation** (`cat dsc dstrace`) — no
transformation, no crypto. **`strip`** removes the front by walking DSC
atoms by length and stopping at the `StreamHeader` atom, yielding the bare lean
stream; the `dsc_hash` binding survives, so a stripped stream still
verifies against a supplied DSC. **`extract`** is free — the bytes
`strip` removes are exactly the `.dsc`.
